discipline: frozen artifacts read only; hashes checked before/after
fit on months 0-5, every choice on month 6, month 7 reported only

rules.selection_rule: fewest leaves meeting the validation target; if none, highest validation recall, then fewest leaves
rules.fallback_reason: No candidate reached the validation recall target within the declared leaf grid.
rules.note: Whole-leaf rules alert every row in an alerted leaf; no row-hash sampling is needed for this operating point.
